purpose: Explore a payoff-improvement architecture in which entry location, loss control and profit taking are separate causal vectors while M9V fresh multi-timeframe forward collection remains unchanged.

path_diagnosis.interpretation: Large losers usually fail to generate meaningful favorable excursion and remain open much longer, but simple time/MFE fail exits also cut too many eventual winners.

recent_m5_or_m15_structure_stops.result: Mostly PF around or below 1 and DD worse than baseline; no simple initial structure stop promoted.

time_plus_mfe_fail_gate.representative_rule: At 60 minutes, if MFE < 0.75 x entry-time M5 ATR, current return < 0, and M5 bullish EMA stack is lost, exit at current M1 open.
time_plus_mfe_fail_gate.decision: REJECT_AS_PRIMARY_IMPROVEMENT; loss size improves but PF/DD do not.

native_exit_leakage.interpretation: M7C native EXIT is a useful state transition but not always an economically optimal full-profit exit. H1 MACD direction at native EXIT provides a simple causal separator for selective runner treatment.

entry_location_finding.definition: Compare first-turn bid/open to the original proxy PRIMARY bid/open using entry-time latest closed M5 ATR14.
entry_location_finding.key_result: Deep unresolved pullback is weaker. Requiring price to reclaim near the original PRIMARY level improves payoff more consistently than trying to buy the deepest first-turn.

immediate_reclaim_group.rule: first-turn entry bid >= original PRIMARY bid

deep_pullback_group.rule: first-turn bid remains >0.5 x M5 ATR below original PRIMARY bid
deep_pullback_group.note: 2024 PF < 1; not a desirable standalone entry-location state.

w1_reclaim_entry_family.concept: Do not blindly take a first-turn while price remains deeply below the PRIMARY level. Require a quick reclaim of a volatility-normalized level; otherwise skip the trade.

reference_rule.level: original PRIMARY bid - 0.10 x ATR14 from latest closed M5 available at first-turn decision
reference_rule.entry: If first-turn bid/open is already >= level, enter normally. Otherwise observe at most 10 fully closed M1 bars; after the first M1 close >= level, enter at the next exact M1 open with historical spread. If no reclaim before timeout/native exit, skip.

neighborhood.interpretation: The improvement is not isolated to exactly 0.10 ATR / 10 minutes. Most nearby combinations remain materially above baseline PF, although weak quarters remain. Do not optimize to the single best cell.

separate_profit_vector.runner_eligibility: At native M7C LONG_EXIT, latest fully closed H1 MACD(6,13) line is still rising versus its previous closed H1 bar.
separate_profit_vector.runner_exit: First later M15 decision whose latest fully closed M15 RCI9 makes a causal turn-down (current < previous and previous >= previous2).
separate_profit_vector.note: This treats native M7C EXIT as a profit-management event rather than an unconditional 100% economic exit.

risk_vector.n6_reference: H4 RCI9 percentile within trailing 100 fully closed H4 bars is >25% and <=50% at actual entry decision.
risk_vector.action: 0.5 risk/size for N6 only; do not suppress the signal.

w1_combined_payoff_family.interpretation: A broad 25%-100% runner family remains viable historically. Increasing runner share lowers win rate but converts payoff toward genuine positive reward/risk. 50%-75% is a useful central research range rather than choosing the historical optimum.

remaining_weakness.interpretation: The architecture improves aggregate/yearly payoff but does not eliminate all subperiod weakness. It must not be called complete or forward validated.

do_not_pursue: native M7C EXIT as mandatory 100% economic exit
decision.next: Create a deterministic M9X reproduction/robustness implementation for W1 entry-reclaim and runner-share family, preserving M9V fresh forward unchanged. Only after deterministic reproduction should a separate future payoff shadow be considered.
